author: SourPinata
quote: GTA VI is a good game, but I can’t say it quite lived up to my expectations. The world is impressive, and there’s clearly a ridiculous amount of detail put into it, but some aspects of the experience left me wanting more.After waiting so many years, I think I expected a little more innovation and a bigger leap forward in certain areas. It’s still an enjoyable experience, but I don’t think it’s quite the masterpiece I was hoping for.Rockstar has set the bar incredibly high with its previous releases, which might be part of the problem. It’s a solid entry in the series, just not quite the game-changing experience I expected.
